notes: REF-BM-02: extract-metadata.ts collects title, description and favicon/icon candidates but never a preview/og:image; no preview_image column exists. REF-BM-10: tag entry is a plain comma-separated text field (BookmarkEditor); repo has findPartial() but it is wired to no route or UI, and there is no datalist/autocomplete. REF-BM-15: tokenizer supports AND/OR, phrases and #tags and the quoting rule works, but NOT (UNSUPPORTED_NEGATION) and parentheses/grouping (UNSUPPORTED_GROUPING) are explicitly rejected, so the spec example `rome (#article or #book)` fails. REF-BM-24: no snapshot capability at all (no HTML archiving, no PDF-download rule, no route/table). REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/Wayback integration. REF-BM-29: saved views (SavedViewWrite) persist scope/query/included tags/sort as a reusable bundle but have no excluded-tags facet. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export route/code. REF-BM-32: no user-settings entity or endpoints; no default-sort/displayed-items/font-size personal settings (sort lives only in per-view URL state).
